title: (fix) O3-5705: Use netAmount instead of totalAmount for balance due on printable invoice
body: ## Requirements - [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/docs/frontend-modules/contributing.en-US#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration. - [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui)) - [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests. ## Summary The balance due shown on the printable invoice was calculated using `totalAmount` instead of `netAmount`. This caused the displayed balance to be incorrect when discounts were applied, as `totalAmount` does not account for discounts while `netAmount` does. ## Screenshots Before: After: ## Related Issue https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5705 ## Other
